item.title: British trio lose European finals but claim silvers
item.description: Chantelle Reid, Abdul Burton and Damar Thomas are all beaten in their final bouts at the European Boxing Championships.

item.title: 'Bosh', backlash and rebuild - how far can Fisher go?
item.description: British heavyweight Johnny Fisher - who returns to the Copper Box for his Zuffa Boxing debut on Saturday - reflects on defeat, fame and his rebuild.

item.title: Collins ready for 'sink or swim' return after pain of missing title shot
item.description: Nathaniel Collins says the first loss of his career has taught him the importance of patience in the ring as he prepares to fight Liam Davies on Saturday.

item.description: BBC Sport takes a look at the compromises, power struggles and competing interests behind Tyson Fury v Anthony Joshua.

item.title: Fury v Joshua announced for 11 December in Cardiff
item.description: Cardiff's Principality Stadium will host Anthony Joshua and Tyson Fury's all-British heavyweight fight on 11 December.

item.description: Michaela Walsh settles for bronze at the European Boxing Championships in Bulgaria, while Lisa O'Rourke banks gold for Team Ireland.

item.title: Burton makes final as GB chase three European golds
item.description: Abdul Burton reaches the men's super-bantamweight final after Callum Makin and Dimeji Shittu claim bronzes at the European Boxing Championships.

item.title: Itauma 'humiliated' but may never lose again - Hrgovic
item.description: Moses Itauma may never lose again if he can get over the "humiliation" of his IBF heavyweight title defeat, says Filip Hrgovic, who stunned the Briton in August.

item.title: GB's Reid and Thomas reach finals at Europeans
item.description: Great Britain's Chantelle Reid and Damar Thomas will fight for gold at the European Boxing Championships after semi-final victories on Wednesday.

item.title: Walsh and O'Rourkes advance but McConnell and Gallagher out
item.description: Michaela Walsh sealed Team Ireland's fourth medal at the European Boxing Championships in Bulgaria, but Jude Gallagher misses out on a split decision while Jon McConnell must settle for bronze.

item.title: Lopez ordered to defend world title v Catterall
item.description: Briton Jack Catterall is one step closer to a second world title shot, having lost his previous one in 2022.

item.title: Brown sets sights on British title
item.description: British boxer Pat Brown is facing John Hedges in his hometown of Manchester on Saturday, but says his ultimate dream is to one day fight at Old Trafford.

item.title: A car in the gym? At home with Conor Benn
item.description: Go behind the scenes at home with Conor Benn, before his Las Vegas showdown with Ryan Garcia.

item.title: 'I grew up watching you' - women's boxing honours Taylor
item.description: Women's boxing greats, including Claressa Shields and Amanda Serrano, pay tribute to Katie Taylor as she prepares to retire after Saturday's fight with Flora Pili.

item.title: Tears, blood and triumph - Taylor's iconic career in pictures
item.description: As Katie Taylor hangs up her gloves, BBC Sport picks the best pictures of her career.

item.title: Five moments that shaped Taylor's legendary career
item.description: From writing a letter to her idol as a 10-year-old to messaging a promoter on social media, here are five sliding doors moments that helped shape Katie Taylor’s career.

item.title: Ali 'The Greatest' but Maguire the latest to win in Croke Park
item.description: With Katie Taylor set to be the first boxer to headline Croke Park since Muhammad Ali beat Al 'Blue' Lewis in 1972, BBC Sport NI catches up with Paddy Maguire, who was last to box on that iconic night.

item.title: From influencers to queens of women's boxing - five years of MVP
item.description: On Saturday, Most Valuable Promotions celebrates its fifth anniversary. One of the feistiest upstarts in modern boxing has given a new platform to the world's best female fighters.

item.title: Heavyweight Itauma handed harsh world-title lesson
item.description: British heavyweight Moses Itauma was taught a harsh lesson at world level - what can he learn from defeat and where does the 21-year-old go next?

item.description: Team Northern Ireland boxer Jon McConnell tells BBC Sport NI of his decision to reject Love Island to pursue his childhood dream of winning Commonwealth gold, which he achieved with a split decision win over Wales' Orlando Holley-Sotomi.

item.title: How lightbulb moment in Hazard's apartment helped Sheeraz

item.title: Are Prince Naseem Hamed's sons coming for his throne?
